I can run a focused 30-min walkthrough of how Redwood handles embeddings pipelines, retrieval latency, and cost tradeoffs. Before we lock a slot, a couple quick qualification questions so I can prep the right demo and bring Ben (our solutions lead) if needed: 

1) Which search latency SLO do you care about (p95 target)? Example: <100ms p95 on end-user queries.

3) What format will you use for candidate content — product descriptions only, or additional metadata (images, attributes)?
4) Pilot scope: is this a production-facing pilot (traffic routed to Redwood) or a staging evaluation with sample data?
5) Any security constraints (SAML SSO, specific IP allowlists, or PCI/PII considerations)?

Thanks Chloe — answers inline below.

> 1) Which search latency SLO do you care about (p95 target)?
We’re aiming for ~120ms p95 initially; sub-100ms would be ideal but not required day one.

> 2) How many concurrent queries at peak do you expect (estimate during promotions)?
Peak concurrency during big sales could be around 250–400 qps sustained for 10–30 minutes; baseline is ~30–40 qps.

> 3) What format will you use for candidate content?
Primarily product title + description + category tags; we may experiment by adding visual embeddings later but not for pilot.

> 4) Pilot scope: production-facing pilot or staging?
Pilot will be behind a feature flag in production for 1–2% of traffic to start — we want real traffic tests.

> 5) Any security constraints?
We use Okta SAML for SSO and need to discuss IP allowlisting and data retention settings; SOC2 evidence will also be required during procurement.

The Thu Jul 20, 14:00–14:30 PST slot works for Alex and me. I booked that slot via the calendar link and added a short doc with traffic breakdown. Calendar event: https://cal.redwood.ai/MEETING/rdw-66421/events/12345

Thanks — looking forward.
Margo
